intro: Kos has the Plane Tree of Hippocrates, the island's most famous tree, in Platia Platanou in the old town. Legend says the father of medicine taught beneath a plane here; the Municipality of Kos says the present tree is no more than five centuries old and may have grown from the original's roots. Its hollow trunk is 12 metres round, and it has been a protected natural monument since 1985.
meta_description: The Plane Tree of Hippocrates in Kos town: how old it really is, what the legend says, and where to find it.
question_meta: The Plane Tree of Hippocrates in Kos town is roughly 400 to 500 years old, by the municipality's own account.
question_answer: The tree to see on Kos is the Plane Tree of Hippocrates, an Oriental Plane in Platia Platanou in Kos town, beside the old Loggia mosque. Legend says Hippocrates taught under a plane here around 400 BC, but the Municipality of Kos says the present tree is no more than five centuries old, so roughly 400 to 500 years.
question_context: The municipality allows that the tree may have grown from a shoot of an older tree's roots, which is how the legend and the dates can both stand. A claim of more than 2,300 years still circulates, and nothing published supports it. The regional tourism site notes that the tree already looked old in nineteenth-century pictures. The municipality gives its trunk a circumference of 12 metres, and the trunk is hollow, eaten out by fungi and wood-boring insects. It has been protected as a natural monument since 1985. Another tradition has seeds from it carried to Montpellier and other medical schools, so planes said to descend from it grow far from Kos. The tree stands on the mound between the ancient port and Finikon Street, in an open public square, free to visit and open at all hours, a few minutes on foot from the harbour and the castle of the Knights.

faq.q: Is the Plane Tree of Hippocrates really 2,400 years old?
faq.a: No. The Municipality of Kos says the present tree cannot be more than five centuries old, though it may have grown from a shoot of the original roots. Roughly 400 to 500 years is the honest age.

faq.q: Where is the Plane Tree of Hippocrates?
faq.a: In Platia Platanou in Kos town, beside the Loggia mosque, a few minutes on foot from the harbour. The square is free and open at all hours.

trees.story:
Hippocrates almost certainly never sat under this tree, and the town that looks after it says so itself. The legend holds that the father of medicine, born on Kos around 460 BC, taught his students beneath a plane in this square. The Municipality of Kos writes that the present tree cannot be more than five centuries old, though it may have grown from a shoot of the original roots.

So the honest age is roughly 400 to 500 years. The regional tourism site adds that it already looked old in nineteenth-century pictures. A claim of more than 2,300 years still circulates, and nothing supports it.

The tree is impressive without the legend. The municipality gives its trunk a circumference of 12 metres, and that trunk is hollow, eaten out by fungi and wood-boring insects. The crown spreads over Platia Platanou, the Plane Tree Square, on the mound between the ancient port and Finikon Street, with the old Loggia mosque beside it.

The legend has travelled further than the tree ever could. Another story has a seed from it carried to Montpellier and to other medical schools, so the tradition of learning under Hippocrates' plane continues in places he never saw.

It has been a protected natural monument since 1985. The square is open at all hours and a few minutes on foot from the harbour and the Knights' castle. This is the island's most famous tree, and it is rarely alone.
trees.how_to_recognise: You can recognise it by the hollow trunk, 12 metres round, the one great plane in Plane Tree Square. It stands opposite the Loggia (Defterdar) mosque, between the ancient port and Finikon Street.
